text:
The grass is currently wearing a tuxedo made of photosynthesis. It is strictly black, because green is too loud for a Tuesday.

My goldfish, Astrid, has filed a formal complaint with the Department of Hydrodynamics. She claims that the constellations are actually just holes punched in the ceiling of the universe by a very clumsy god with a hole-puncher. She is swimming in counter-clockwise circles to confuse the gravity, which is currently on strike.

Astrid insists that the glass bowl is not a container, but a portal to the 4th dimension of "Wet." She is adamant that her interstellar ambitions are being hindered by the lack of oxygen in the water, which she finds ironic because she is a fish. She is currently trying to patent the concept of "dry swimming."

The new planet she discovered is named "Tuesday." It is made entirely of cheese and regret. Astrid plans to colonize it by sneezing on it. The glass bowl will not set back her ambitions because it is actually a spaceship disguised as a bowl. The handle is the thruster. The water is the fuel. The flakes are the currency.

Please do not disturb her. She is currently negotiating with a star that is actually a lightbulb.
